bias.en: Downtrend · rebound stalled under the Jul 29 low
bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 反弹受阻于 7 月 29 日低点下方

read.en: Micron rose 6.3% on Nov 9 to $733.15, trading $689.65–744.46. It is below the falling 5-day ($745.97), 10-day ($829.45), 30-day ($929.27) and 100-day ($956.32) averages and the rising 200-day ($758.39). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($937.67), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 美光 11月9日上涨 6.3%，收于 $733.15，盘中区间 $689.65–744.46。股价位于下行的 5 日（$745.97）、10 日（$829.45）、30 日（$929.27）和 100 日均线（$956.32）以及上行的 200 日均线（$758.39）下方。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$937.67），RSI 为 36。

read.en: The close cleared the $724.8 Nov 6 high, now support, but closed below the $737.88 Jul 29 low. Resistance is $737.9–746 (Jul 29 low, Nov 9 high, 5-day), then $758.4–761.8 (200-day, Nov 5 high) and $782–795. Support is $724.8, then $676–689.7 (Nov 6 and Nov 9 lows) and $650–652. A close above $746 would target $758–762; below $724.8, $676–690.
